```python
import DREAM
from DREAM.Settings import DREAMSettings
from DREAM.Settings.Equations import IonSpecies
from DREAM.Settings.RadialGrid import RadialGrid
from DREAM.Settings.Equations import RunawayElectrons
from DREAM.Settings.Equations import HotElectronDistributionFunction
from DREAM.Settings.Equations import ColdElectrons
from DREAM.Settings.Equations import ElectricField
from DREAM.Settings.Equations import Temperature
from DREAM.Settings.Equations import Ions
from DREAM.Settings.Solver import SolverNonLinear
from DREAM.Settings.TimeStepper import TimeStepper

# Create settings object
ds = DREAMSettings()

# Set up radial grid (single point)
ds.radialgrid.setNr(1)
ds.radialgrid.setMinorRadius(0.22)
ds.radialgrid.setWallRadius(0.23)
ds.radialgrid.setB0(5.0)  # Tesla, arbitrary but required

# Set up momentum grid
ds.hottailgrid.setNxi(20)
ds.hottailgrid.setNp(300)
ds.hottailgrid.setPmax(1.0)  # 1 m_e*c

# Set up time grid
ds.timestep.setTmax(1e-3)
ds.timestep.setNt(20)

# Set constant temperature, density, and electric field
ds.eqsys.T_cold.setPrescribedData(100)         # eV
ds.eqsys.n_cold.setPrescribedData(5e19)        # m^-3
ds.eqsys.E_field.setPrescribedData(6.0)        # V/m

# Set up ions (fully ionized deuterium)
ds.eqsys.n_i.addIon(name='D', Z=1, n=5e19, iontype=IonSpecies.IONTYPE_FULLY_IONIZED)

# Enable runaway generation (avalanche and Dreicer)
ds.eqsys.n_re.setAvalanche(True)
ds.eqsys.n_re.setDreicer(True)

# Set up solver and time stepper
ds.solver.setType(SolverNonLinear)
ds.timestep.setType(TimeStepper.TYPE_LINEAR)

# Set output filename
ds.output.setFilename('output.h5')

# Run simulation
ds.save('input_settings.h5')
DREAM.runiface(ds, 'output.h5')
```
